# One tree's share of the secret-scan allow-list:
#
#     path | rule-id | sha256 fingerprint | reason
#
# The format, what an entry may say, and why this is a directory rather than a
# file are argued once in README.md beside this file. Do not restate them here.
#
# covers: docs/


# The frozen record, and the chapter prose about the redactor.
#
# docs/superpowers is a historical record and CLAUDE.md forbids editing a plan
# to match the code that followed it. So a value printed in one is accepted
# where it is, and pinned by fingerprint so the file staying frozen is
# something this gate can see rather than something it assumes.
#
# Section 13.4's redactor is a component whose whole subject is the shape of a
# credential, so its chapter is full of the shape being described. That is the
# residue the scanner cannot tell from the thing itself, and it is why the
# value rules end at whitespace, a parenthesis and a backtick rather than at
# the end of the line. The source half of the same residue is in src.txt and
# the suite's is in tests.txt.
